sources.entry: MAMA by jungjaehoon-lifegamez - Always-on companion for Claude that remembers your decisions and their evolution. Local-first memory using SQLite + transformers.js embeddings.

summary.one_liner: MAMA is a local-first work agent that runs on your own computer, keeps a versioned record of connected work sources and decisions, and answers you through a messenger, with a Claude Code development-memory plugin built on a shared engine.
summary.what_it_does: MAMA follows conversations, files and schedules in the tools you connect (Chatwork, Slack, Discord, Trello, Notion, Telegram, Google Calendar/Gmail/Drive/Sheets via the gws command, iCal, Obsidian, iMessage, Claude Code projects) and stores each collected item as an original observation in a local SQLite database. Work items keep revision histories that record what changed, why, the evidence, and who was involved. You talk to it in Telegram, Discord or Slack; it answers from stored history, sends scheduled reports (08:00, 13:00, 18:00) and hourly reminders, and saves corrections as guidance or workflows. Each registered person gets a DM session with their own records and jobs, and the agent runs on Claude or Codex CLI. The same repository provides Claude Code development memory (decisions and checkpoints across sessions) as an MCP server and plugin, both built on the mama-core engine.
use_cases: keep a running record of decisions on a work project
answer 'who is working on what' from connected chats and boards
send scheduled progress reports to a messenger
remember corrections and apply them to future tasks
persist Claude Code decisions and checkpoints across sessions
local search over chat, mail and note history
how_to_run: Send your Telegram bot a message once MAMA reports it is running
For Claude Code development memory: /plugin install mama, or add the MCP server {"mcpServers":{"mama":{"command":"npx","args":["@jungjaehoon/mama-server"]}}}
stack: Telegram, Discord or Slack bot APIs
notable: Local-first: no hosted service; the record stays on the user's machine
Revision history per work item, with the message or file behind each change
Per-person DM sessions with their own records and scheduled jobs
Shared mama-core engine that other products can build on
Viewer on 127.0.0.1 by default, with Cloudflare Access support for remote access
caveats: Roadmap states it runs on the developer's Mac today; 1.0 (anyone can install, Linux/Docker) is only 12 of 52 items done
Discord and Slack have not run live yet; Windows is not planned for 1.0
Codex backend searches the web but does not open pages
